observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation console standing upright on a small stand, with a visible PlayStation logo on the front/top area.
Photo 0 shows a controller placed in front of the console (appears to be a DualSense-style controller).
Photo 1 shows a close front view of the same white console with the controller docked/placed in front; no ports/cables are visible.
No model revision details (e.g., CUH/CFI code) are readable in the photos.
No accessories (HDMI, power cable, stand, box) are shown.

claims.claim: Ps5 console fat uk used with 1 pad
claims.evidence: Photos show a white PS console and one controller, but the exact PS5 model/revision ('fat') and 'UK' region are not readable.

risks.risk: Exact PS5 model/revision is unclear (could be different PS5 variants; pricing varies).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label showing the model/CFI code (e.g., CFI-xxxx) and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest/most common used PS5 variant with unknown revision; treat as not confirmed for the seller’s specific 'fat' claim.

risks.risk: Region/UK specification not verifiable from photos.
risks.proof: Photo of the box label or console label showing region/voltage details (or a screenshot of system settings region).
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming UK-specific compatibility; treat as standard used unit.

risks.risk: Working condition (disc drive, HDMI output, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, audio, ports) not testable from photos.
risks.proof: Short video showing power-on to the home screen, audio output, and (if disc version) inserting a disc and playing it.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested; assume worst case for functionality (e.g., disc drive not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Storage capacity (e.g., 825GB vs 1TB) not shown; affects value.
risks.proof: Photo of System Settings → Storage (or a screenshot showing total storage).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the smaller/lowest common storage option.

risks.risk: Controller condition (drift, buttons, charging) not verifiable.
risks.proof: Video of controller connected showing stick calibration/inputs and a quick gameplay movement test; also show charging/charging indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controller may have minor wear; do not assume perfect condition.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console label (CFI/model code + serial).
Video: power on to home screen and show system settings (region + storage).
If it’s the disc version: video inserting and playing a disc; if digital: show library download/play.
Video test of the controller (no stick drift; button responsiveness) and charging.
response.reason: The photos confirm a white PS5-like console and one controller, but the key details that determine the correct PS5 variant/price (exact model/CFI code, region, and confirmed working status) are not readable or testable from the images.
